sentences.text: The main matter stands compromised with the other named persons in the FIR, vide Settlement dated 20.09.2023.

However, the sister-in-law and the brother-in-law have been left out of that settlement essentially because petitioner No. 2 had gone to U.K. for further studies and her husband and children accompanied her.
It is also submitted that the petitioner has started residing with her husband, though the FIR is still pending.
6. Notice of the Petition be issued to the complainant through IO, returnable on 01.08.2024 and the status report be also submitted before the next date of hearing.
7. It is submitted that another Petition No. 2075/2024, has also been filed by the petitioners seeking protection from any coercive action, which is now listed for 19.09.2024.
Learned counsel submits that she would be moving an application for early hearing to get the same listed on the same date.
NEENA BANSAL KRISHNA, J JULY 11, 2024/RS
